answer: Yes, this is a real bug. Root cause: sim/batch_formation.go preemptForTokens() resets ProgressIndex=0 on preempted requests, causing sim/simulator.go executeBatchStep() to re-count output tokens already generated before preemption. With 265 preemptions (--total-kv-blocks 600), total_output_tokens was inflated by 9,548 tokens (9.1%) from 105,082 to 114,630. The fix stores OutputTokensGenerated in PreemptedRequest before the ProgressIndex reset and subtracts it in the preemption handler. It also resets TTFTSet/FirstTokenTime and ITL to prevent TTFT and ITL double-counting. Post-fix, total_output_tokens=105,082 for all KV cache sizes. Regression test TestSimulator_PreemptionDoesNotInflateTotalOutputTokens added.
repro: ./blis run --model qwen/qwen3-14b --rate 20 --num-requests 200 --seed 42 --total-kv-blocks 600 2>/dev/null | grep total_output_tokens && ./blis run --model qwen/qwen3-14b --rate 20 --num-requests 200 --seed 42 --total-kv-blocks 60000 2>/dev/null | grep total_output_tokens
